verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection scoring and decisioning API platform, not an AI agent or assistant host. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers and calls their tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Sift ships any agent or tool-calling client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
